description: This file contains unit tests for RPC (Remote Procedure Call) mechanisms within the Thunder project, specifically testing the 'Adder' interface implementation, stub, proxy, and communication setup using Google Test framework.

classes.name: Thunder::Tests::Core::Exchange::IAdder
classes.description: Interface for an Adder service with methods to get value, add a number, and get process ID.
